reviews.title: Well built, quiet, fully modular, PCIe 5.1 & 12V-2x6 support, great price for a 850W unit
reviews.comment: This “MONTECH Century II - 850W High-End ATX Gaming Power Supply - 80 Plus Gold & Cybenetics Platinum - Fully Modular - ATX 3.1 & PCIe 5.1 Ready with 12V-2x6 Cable - 10 Years Warranty” checked all the boxes for me! I am building a gaming PC with a mATX motherboard in the smallest mATX case I can find. I should have used a SFX (small form-factor) PSU but most of them (in this wattage that I needed) are more expensive than I am willing to pay. Then I found THIS one, even though it is NOT SFX (this is actually a full sized ATX PSU), due to the fact that it is fully modular (I only need to install the cables I needed to use), and also it has 12V-2x6 to support my GeForce RTX 4070 Ti, I am still able to fit this into the case nicely. For a 850W, 80 plus gold & cybernetics platinum, with 10 years warranty unit, the price ($90) is great. Even at full blown operation, it is still running cool and quiet. It is very well built, the enclosure is nice and pretty, and all the cables seem to be of good quality. Thank you for reading this review, I hope that this review & the pictures are helpful to you in support of your purchase decision.
